name: Parking garage
description: Open three-deck concrete parking garage, 40 x 30 m: a ground level and two decks under an open roof deck (four parking levels), linked by a straight stacked ramp bay along the east side between full-height ramp walls, two stair cores in the west corners rising to roof doors, square columns with yellow guard paint, downstand beams, low precast parapets with coping and open bands above, painted bays, wheel stops, direction arrows, ceiling lights and roof lamp posts. The street entrance has two entry lanes and an exit lane with barrier arms, a pay station and a height bar.
